'''Foless Spaceport Authority''' was an organization on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Foless/Legends|Foless]].<ref name="Strange Allies" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Annual">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' places the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. The battle takes place just prior to the ''Secret Missions'' series.</ref> two of its [[Officer/Legends|officers]] investigated the arrival of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Nuru Kungurama]], who had unknowingly traveled in the company of a [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]]. Kungurama and his ally [[Gizman|Gizz]] stole the officers' [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] to chase after [[Kuvuta Pindi]]. During that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Spaceport Authority officers wore [[Color/Legends|blue uniforms]] with a silver helmet and tinted goggles, along with silver gloves and [[Boot/Legends|boots]] and belt.<ref name="Strange Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
Foless Spaceport Authority appears in [[2011]]'s ''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]'', a comic tie-in to the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Secret Missions]]'' series.
